versions.content: For Synchronized Time Bases if • StbMIsSystemWideGlobalTimeMaster is set to False • and StbMRateCorrectionThreshold is greater than 0, then the StbM shall check if the absolute value of the calculated rate deviation exceeds the configured value of StbMRateCorrectionThreshold . If the threshold is exceeded, then the StbM shall set the RATE_EXCEEDED bit within timeBaseStatus of the Time Base and shall consider the calculated rate deviation as not valid. If the threshold is not exceeded, then the StbM shall clear the RATE_EXCEEDED bit within timeBaseStatus of the Time Base.
